sections.heading: In-Game Description (Harunaga's)
sections.text:
This is truly precious bait.
If bait has hair, you know it's something truly special.
The Hirata noble in the pot is obsessed with thoughts of becoming a "master".
"He who receives the scales of the carp becomes closer to a carp himself... I bestow unto you my secret treasure."

sections.heading: In-Game Description (Koremori's)
sections.text:
This is truly precious bait.
If bait has hair, you know it's something truly special.
The Fountainhead Palace noble in the pot is obsessed with becoming one with the "master".
"Present this bait to the master, the Great Carp. Offer it earnestly, but quietly, so no one knows..."

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text:
Offer to the Great Coloured Carp by ringing the bell near the Feeding Grounds Sculptor's Idol: upon reloading the area the Great Carp will be dead and its corpse found in the Guardian Ape's Watering Hole alongside its Great White Whisker.
The Noble whose Bait is offered will become a Treasure Carp himself, leaving behind Lapis Lazuli [x1] near his jar, and will inherit the entire stock of the other, who'll disappear from the game for the rest of the playthrough.
